mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is active whenever the rate is trending downward, regardless of absolute level.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market deterioration signaled by unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% in the prior month indicates weakening economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and monetary policy tightening (FEDFUNDS) signal an aggressive central bank response to inflation, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS have risen in the prior month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 310), the Federal Reserve's tendency to implement aggressive monetary tightening leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 310, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1300 thousand units in the prior month signals weak consumer demand for housing, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST falls below 1300, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high residential sales regime (RSAFS > 700,000), strong consumer demand for housing signals robust economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS exceeds 700,000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) over the prior month indicates expanding manufacturing output, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO has risen in the prior month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) signal a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS has risen and UNRATE has fallen in the prior month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.
